messages:
Marin (PM): quick thread to finalize a low-friction acceptance path for the next design-partner intake. want fewer partial signups and clearer acceptance signals.
Saeed (PartnerOps): current pain = drop-off on NDA + calendar steps. propose a one-tap calendar accept in the invite and a short 12-business-day RSVP window.
Jon (Platform Eng): infra note: we can auto-provision a sandbox key on NDA click. default quotas = 150k tokens/week. add a soft cap and an easy 'request more' flow that routes to infra.
Clara (Research): signal change request: ask for 3 short prompts but allow one to be optional if partner chooses quick-apply. require a brief "success metric" field so we can prioritize research sessions.
Vik (Legal): intake must include a clear telemetry opt-in checkbox and a short link to pilot terms. we can auto-apply a standard NDA for SMBs; enterprise partners still get manual review. flag any PHI/FIN for legal hold.
Marin (PM): acceptance rubric idea: 0-5 each on technical fit, impact, readiness, sensitivity. score >=13 -> auto-accept + sandbox; 10-12 -> PO review; <10 -> nurture lane.
Saeed (PartnerOps): nurture lane = automated email with docs + invite to reapply; we'll auto-remind non-responders at day 4 and day 9, escalate to PO at day 11. onboard-bot will handle pings.
onboard-bot: automation scheduled: reminders day 4 & 9; escalate day 11; post intake summary to #dp-ops when score >=13.
Jon (Platform Eng): operational guardrail: freeze model/serving profile 72h before cohort start. provide a fallback model for regressions; rollback plan must be documented in runbook.
Clara (Research): quick-test flow: after intake we run a 10-minute quick-test against seed prompts and surface three metrics: pass rate, latency median, hallucination signal. require at least one passing partner before cohort kickoff.
Marin (PM): incentives: base credits 300 + 1 research call; milestone credits for completing 3 weekly evals and a feedback interview; co-marketing only for enterprise level.
Vik (Legal): include optional log-sharing consent and residency picker on intake; no logs shipped without explicit consent.
Saeed (PartnerOps): owners: Saeed = invites & nurture, Jon = infra & provisioning, Clara = quick-test config, Vik = legal text, Marin = cohort decisioning. target send = next Wed.
Marin (PM): ok if everyone aligns i'll post the invite draft to #product-docs for a 24h review and schedule a 15-min sign-off tomorrow. :seedling:
